# R execution acceptance

```{r}
stopifnot(!exists('total'))
writeLines(c(as.character(Sys.getpid()), commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)[1]), 'process.txt')
cat('executed\n', file = 'runs.txt', append = TRUE)
total <- sum(c(2, 4, 6))
```

```{r}
cat(sprintf('total = %d\n', total))
message('intentional stderr')
IRdisplay::publish_mimebundle(list('text/html' = '<strong>safe html</strong>', 'text/plain' = 'html fallback'))
IRdisplay::publish_mimebundle(list('text/markdown' = '**total:** `12`', 'text/plain' = 'markdown fallback'))
IRdisplay::publish_mimebundle(list('image/svg+xml' = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="20">12</text></svg>', 'text/plain' = 'figure fallback'))
```

```{r}
IRdisplay::publish_mimebundle(list('application/javascript' = 'rejected payload'))
IRdisplay::publish_mimebundle(list('application/javascript' = 'rejected payload', 'text/plain' = 'safe fallback'))
```

```{r}
#| error: true
stop('allowed error')
```

```{r}
stopifnot(total == 12)
cat('state survived the error\n')
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
stop('must be skipped')
```
